input.subject: Nami
input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Refine this newly generated current-campaign Nami through the standard pipeline, resolving the actual failed source review. Remove unsupported movement slow statuses from primary and Raitei and remove every contactStun modifier. Do not recast those as other invented hostile debuffs. Replace affected Weather Preparation purchases with concrete, cumulative primary timing improvements based on practiced weather setup, preserving three meaningful paths for damage / preparation cadence / range and Zeus-assisted target handling. All15 purchases must improve real behavior. Preserve source-backed lightning, Gust Sword displacement, Wano Zeus inside Sorcery Clima-Tact, Heat Egg with explicit authored delivery limitation, and every unrelated form/attack/resource/mechanics number unless affected by the correction. Keep prices provisional for measured balance next. Update names and descriptions to reflect removal of slows/stuns; call her weather artillery rather than promise unsupported electrical control. Highest-tier shared Technique replacement remains. Do not claim fresh research was unavailable; captured knowledge is fresh same-campaign research. Do not implement later-arc feats. Keep root description below1700 characters. Source facts and numerical game tuning must be distinguished. Return entire valid unit, not a patch.

candidateToRefine.name: Nami — Art of Weather
candidateToRefine.description: Stationary Straw Hat weather controller, manga through Wano. Her Sorcery Clima-Tact launches lightning, scheduled Heat Egg projectiles, Gust Sword displacement and Raitei. Zeus resides in the weapon at placement, not a summoned standalone body. Generous collision tolerance and optional prelaunch retargeting approximate his assistance; true homing, weapon reshaping and consciousness transfer are omitted. Thunderbolt Tempo and Raitei's slows are explicit game-only additions for this weather-control adaptation, not effects established by the supplied Wano-era evidence. After positive damage, slowable targets receive 0.8 speed for 1.8 or 3 seconds respectively; duration refreshes without stacking magnitude. Purchased contact stuns are also game-only additions, not sourced canonical powers. All numbers, prices, schedules, tier unlocks and stamina costs are provisional tuning, not canon measurements or measured balance. Stamina represents Technique preparation, not transformation exhaustion. The highest purchased tier on any path unlocks Gust Sword at 1 and Raitei at 5. Only the highest unlocked contextual Technique in the current form occupies the single button; lower-tier Techniques have no separate permanent buttons. Purchases are cumulative under the maximum 5-2-0 rule. Enemy movement is caller-supplied. Mirage Tempo, Fata Morgana, Milky Road terrain/travel, showers, Impact Dial absorption/recoil, navigation, theft, negotiation and financial management are omitted. No regeneration denial, healing, ally damage buffs or elemental-immunity bypass.

paths.name: Thundercloud Output
paths.description: Personal lightning and Technique damage specialization. Heat Egg remains a separate static scheduled attack and receives none of these purchases. Damage scaling is provisional gameplay tuning, not a new power or a claim that Raitei defeats every opponent in one hit. Zeus's Wano integration follows Hera seemingly consuming his former body, the Clima-Tact speaking, and his survival within it being explained. Only the highest unlocked contextual Technique is exposed through the shared button.

upgrades.name: Charged Weather Balls
upgrades.description: Adds 4 damage to the primary and all Techniques. Highest tier 1 also unlocks stamina and Gust Sword.

upgrades.name: Denser Thundercloud
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by 1.2 after flat additions.

upgrades.name: Larger Charge Reserve
upgrades.description: Adds another 8 damage to the primary and all Techniques; does not change or refill stamina.

upgrades.name: Concentrated Discharge
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by a further 1.3.

upgrades.name: Zeus-Amplified Thunder
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by a further 1.45. Highest tier 5 replaces Gust Sword with Raitei through the shared Technique button; Zeus was already present in the weapon.

paths.name: Weather Preparation
paths.description: Improves personal weather setup and adds game-only lightning interruption. Timing reductions adapt practiced Clima-Tact preparation, not navigation-based speed magic. The supplied evidence establishes weather science and lightning, but not these contact stuns or the primary and Raitei slows. These control effects are explicit additions for this game's controller role, not canonical Nami abilities or inferred Wano feats. Slowing thematically compresses heat/cool preparation without simulating that preparation. Contact stuns require both weakWilled and stunnable; existing stun and the following protection interval block new stuns. No purchase improves scheduled Heat Egg. Only the highest unlocked contextual Technique is exposed.

upgrades.name: Prepared Heat and Cool Mix
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and period by 0.9. Technique timing is unchanged.

upgrades.name: Brief Electrical Interruption
upgrades.description: Game-only control addition, not a sourced canonical lightning effect: eligible primary contacts stun for 0.35 seconds. Requires both weakWilled and stunnable; existing stun and its following protection interval block application.

upgrades.name: Efficient Cloud Assembly
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and period by a further 0.85; does not accelerate Techniques or Heat Egg.

upgrades.name: Sustained Electrical Interruption
upgrades.description: Raises the game-only eligible primary contact stun from 0.35 to 0.75 seconds rather than adding durations. This is authored control tuning, not a canonical Nami feat; the same eligibility and protection checks apply.

upgrades.name: Weatheria Setup Mastery
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary timing by a further 0.8 and raises the game-only eligible contact stun to 1 second, retaining eligibility and protection checks. The stun is not established by Wano-era evidence. Tier 5 supplies Raitei through the shared Technique button.

paths.name: Cloud Placement
paths.description: Extends personal acquisition reach and improves prelaunch target handling. Reach is an abstract deployment limit for localized weather, not staff length. Zeus-assisted retargeting replaces one lost primary target only before launch; projectiles never home or retarget after launch, and Techniques never retarget. Mirage Tempo and Fata Morgana are omitted optical deception: this encounter has no defensive targeting or evasion, so they grant no fake damage, concealment detection or taunt. Only the highest unlocked contextual Technique is exposed.

upgrades.name: Extended Cloud Placement
upgrades.description: Adds 4 personal reach, taking the unmodified base reach from 40 to 44.

upgrades.name: Zeus Checks the Target
upgrades.description: Enables one replacement for a lost primary target before launch without restarting windup. No postlaunch steering or Technique retargeting.

upgrades.name: Distant Cloud Positioning
upgrades.description: Adds another 6 personal reach, reaching 50 on this path. Does not change Heat Egg range or projectile speed.

upgrades.name: Stable Long-Range Discharge
upgrades.description: Adds 5 personal reach and 5 damage to the primary and all Techniques.

upgrades.name: Far-Reaching Thundercloud
upgrades.description: Adds 5 personal reach, reaching 60 on this path, and multiplies primary and all Technique damage by 1.25. Tier 5 supplies Raitei; its larger collision tolerance remains an aimed-shot abstraction.

context.independentReview: Pipeline review rejected unsourced primary/Raitei slows and purchased contact stuns. Wano cutoff excludes S-Shark later feat. Heat Egg launched delivery is disclosed adaptation; no invented canon projectile feat.

knowledge.subject: Nami
gaps: The supplied pages do not provide the requested game's current contract, supported schema details beyond the output schema, legal path structure, purchase costs, unlock schedules, projectile-flight rules, target geometry, status definitions, or shared-technique lifecycle. A playable implementation cannot be verified against those rules from the supplied evidence.

Any numerical tuning, damage values, ranges, cooldowns, resource costs, status durations, companion behavior, and purchase sequencing would be game adaptations rather than canon facts and require separate disclosure and balancing evidence.

The pages support weather manipulation, lightning, heat, mirages, wind, cloud creation, and Zeus's sentient Clima-Tact integration, but do not establish arbitrary regeneration negation, generic slowing as a canon effect, shields, taunt, healing, or attack-speed magic.

The requested cutoff excludes material after Wano. Source 9523e2588612aa9f0bd5b51f contains later Egghead and Elbaf claims, including attacks against S-Snake, Saturn, and Road; those claims were not used.

The supplied evidence does not establish a complete list of every Nami technique or every limitation through the end of Wano, so unsupported requested features should remain omitted rather than inferred.

gaps: This is a bounded review of the attached passages and supplied game contract, not independent verification of every manga event or a measured balance assessment.
Damage, reach, flight parameters, collision geometry, displacement magnitude, timing and purchase factors are disclosed numerical adaptations. Their exact values are not canon measurements.

The stamina schedule is explicitly host-game Technique-preparation bookkeeping, not a claim of transformation exhaustion, bodily healing, self-generated fuel or a canon replenishment rate. The evidence does not establish a literal numerical preparation reserve.

Mirages, weapon reshaping, consciousness transfer, cloud travel, showers, Impact Dial behavior and noncombat skills are intentionally omitted. Their source existence does not mean the candidate implements them; no defining ability specifically required by this refinement is omitted.

The Wano portion of the Zeus passage is used, but its later S-Shark, Saturn and Road material is excluded. The current candidate contains no primary/Raitei slow, contactStun purchase or replacement hostile debuff.
Purchase prices and runtime quality still require measured balance and implementation testing; source review alone cannot establish enjoyable play.
